title: Actions pinned to their release
assertion: Every `uses:` is a full SHA with its version, one SHA per action; the SHA is the tag's and every input is declared; every action nested in a composite is pinned by SHA too; the release restores no cache; every Trivy step runs the Trivy whose archive matches tools/trivy/release.txt's SHA-256, never setup-trivy's install; no checkout that keeps no token makes a partial clone, no step fetches this repository, and every gh step sets GH_TOKEN
noFileReason: Every workflow file is read; the actions' tags and files are synthetic ls-remote lines and action files the tests build in memory; no file.
